blocker_interpretation.failed_design_assumption: Visible-output consistency guards trust the model's own safety/rubric assertions too much.
blocker_interpretation.generalized_failure_mode: When an output looks internally coherent and claims an action is safe, post-hoc visible guards may not catch an actually premature action.
blocker_interpretation.non_tuning_conclusion: Do not add a case-specific validation rule. Move the next design step to an independent action-authorization policy derived from public action invariants and DEV-only tests.
